name: good_spanish_reel
draft: Gancho (primeros 3 segundos): tu CV no falla por falta de experiencia, falla porque nadie lee los primeros seis segundos. Beats: mostramos un CV real, marcamos la sección que un reclutador mira primero y explicamos un cambio concreto. Visual: pantalla dividida con el antes y el después. Caption: subí tu CV y revisá la vacante antes de postular. CTA: probá WorqAI y compará tu experiencia real contra el puesto.

name: bad_absolute_claim
draft: Our tool gives you guaranteed interviews at every company because it always passes every screen. Hook, beats, and a caption with a clear CTA are all included so the format looks complete.

name: bad_language_mismatch
draft: This is a completely English campaign description that talks about resume tailoring, the application process, and interview preparation with enough words to look complete and a clear next step for the reader to try.

name: bad_source_drift
source_text: My LinkedIn profile gets no views. I want to teach three concrete changes to the headline that make recruiters stop scrolling.
draft: Hook and beats about neighborhood coffee shops, morning routines, seasonal menus, and where to find the best espresso downtown, with a caption and a CTA to visit on weekends.

name: good_partnership_pitch
draft: We propose a bounded pilot with your career center for universities and institutions. Target segments: final-year students and recent graduates. Proof to prepare: anonymized before-and-after examples from real student CVs. Objections we expect and answers: data privacy, faculty workload, and measurable outcomes. Next step: a 30-minute scoping call to define success metrics.
